data.one_liner: Library to run SQLite migrations with sqflite in Flutter
data.what_it_does: It lets you define an initial schema and a list of migration scripts that are executed when opening a database. The helper opens the database, runs the init script if needed, then applies each migration in order.
use_when: You need to evolve a local SQLite schema over app releases
You already use sqflite and want a simple migration helper
avoid_when: You prefer a code‑generation based migration tool
You need advanced migration features like version rollback or complex schema diff
weaknesses: Limited to raw SQL scripts, no schema diff
data.setup_notes: Add dependency and import package, then call openDatabaseWithMigration with a MigrationConfig

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides schema migration with code generation and type safety

alternatives.name: sqflite_common
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core sqflite implementation, but no migration helper
